title: A Horizon for the Gravity
author: Quentin Delacroix
blurb: Oscar Underhill, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
